workday:nvidia:/job/India-Bengaluru/Veri.title: Verification Engineer, PCIE
workday:nvidia:/job/India-Bengaluru/Veri.text:
NVIDIA is seeking an elite Senior Verification Engineer to verify the design and implementation of the next generation of PCI Express controllers for the world’s leading GPUs and SOCs. This position offers the opportunity to have real impact in a dynamic, technology-focused company impacting product lines ranging from consumer graphics to self-driving cars and the growing field of artificial intelligence. We have crafted a team of outstanding people stretching around the globe, whose mission is to push the frontiers of what is possible today and define the platform for the future of computing. At NVIDIA, our employees are passionate about parallel and visual computing. We're united in our quest to transform the way graphics are used to solve some of the most complex problems in computer science.

The GPU started out as an engine for simulating human imagination, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Today, NVIDIA’s GPU simulates human intelligence, running deep learning algorithms and acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. NVIDIA is increasingly known as “the AI computing company.”

What you’ll be doing:

Be responsible for verification of the ASIC design, architecture, golden models and micro-architecture of PCIE controllers at IP/sub-system levels using state-of-the-art verification methodologies such as UVM.

Build reusable bus functional models, monitors, checkers and scoreboards following coverage driven verification methodology.

Expected to understand the design specification and implementation, define the verification scope, develop test plans, tests, and the verification infrastructure and verify the correctness of the design.

You will be collaborating with architects, designers, and pre and post silicon verification teams to accomplish your tasks.

What we need to see: 

B.Tech./ M.Tech or equivalent experience 

2+ years of relevant experience 

Experience in verification at Unit/Sub-system/SOC level and expertise in Verilog and SystemVerilog

Expertise in comprehensive verification of IP or interconnect protocols (e.g. PCI Express, USB, SATA)

Experience in developing and working in functional coverage based constrained random verification environments

Background in DV methodologies like UVM/VMM and exposure to industry standard verification tools for simulation and debug

Ways to stand out from the crowd: 

Excellent knowledge of PCIE protocol - Gen3 and above 

Good understanding of the system level architecture of PCIE/CXL-based designs

Perl, Python or similar scripting and SW programming language experience

Good debugging and analytical skills

Good interpersonal skills & dream to work as a great teammate

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the most desirable employers in the world. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us. If you are creative, autonomous and love a challenge, we want to hear from you. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Firmware Automation Test Engineer (Python)

  This role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:
   
Compute at HPE helps organizations power their edge-to-cloud platform with proven, workload-optimized products, solutions, and services. Our leading supercomputing technologies enable customers to transform and modernize their IT infrastructure, solve complex problems and support new business opportunities with purpose-built infrastructure and software. Join us redefine what’s next for you.

What you'll do:

Design enhancements, updates, and programming changes for portions and subsystems and software tests.
Execute and author testing plans, protocols, and documentation for assigned portions of applications; identify and debug issues with code, recommending changes or improvements as needed.
Analyse system designs to determine coding, programming, and integration activities required based on specific objectives and established project guidelines.
Develop and maintain manual and automated test cases, ensuring thorough test coverage of embedded software features and functionalities.
Participate as a key member of project teams, collaborating with other software systems engineers and internal or outsourced development partners to deliver reliable, cost-effective, and high-quality solutions.
Collaborate and communicate regularly with internal and outsourced partners regarding software systems design status, project progress, and issue resolution.
Lead or contribute to the validation and resolution of complex technical issues, facilitating effective team decision-making.
Continuously improve testing methodologies, tools, and processes to enhance software quality and reliability.

What you need to bring:

Education and Experience Required: 
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
Minimum 5+ years’ of experience in embedded software testing and development.

Knowledge and Skills: 
Strong BIOS/UEFI, firmware, and server platform validation knowledge.
Experience in end-to-end test planning, execution, defect analysis, and release qualification.
Hands-on expertise in Python-based test automation and firmware debugging.
Ability to drive quality initiatives and collaborate effectively across engineering teams.
Familiarity with AI/GenAI tools to improve test design, automation, debugging, developing AI agents to increase the productivity.
Good with Python scripting and test automation development.
Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) methodologies and Agile development practices.
Proficiency with software systems design tools and programming languages (e.g., Python, C, Go).
Expertise in software systems testing methodology, including creation and execution of test plans, debugging, and use of testing scripts and tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to apply these to complex system-level challenges.
Experience designing software systems running on multiple platform types.
Solid understanding of computer system architecture, devices, and communication protocols.
Familiarity with embedded Linux, device drivers, and related technologies.
Outstanding written and verbal communication skills; mastery of English and local language.
Ability to effectively communicate design proposals, negotiate technical options, and facilitate collaborative solutions.

Additional Skills
Proven leadership capabilities with a strong focus on execution and results.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Knowledge of fault-tolerant systems and high-availability architectures is an advantage.

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.

Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

Personal & Professional Development
We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

workday:nvidia:/job/India-Bengaluru/Mixe.title: Mixed-Signal Design Engineer – RTL and Co-Simulation
workday:nvidia:/job/India-Bengaluru/Mixe.text:
We are seeking a Mixed-Signal Engineer to work on analog–digital co-simulation and digital RTL design for a power controller. The digital RTL implements the full control loop, including protections, fault handling, and calibration. This is a unique role with complete system-level exposure and the opportunity to influence both analog and digital design. The engineer should be flexible as priorities shift between co-simulation, RTL development, and debugging.
 
NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work , to amplify human creativity and intelligence. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
 
What you'll be doing:
Build and run co-simulations that connect digital RTL with analog circuits or SPICE and Verilog-A models.
Enhance and maintain the RTL for the power controller’s full digital control loop.
Verify startup, steady-state, transient, calibration, and fault behavior at the system level in either a purely digital or a co-simulation environment.
Debug issues across the analog–digital boundary with analog and digital designers.
Develop RTL behavioral models for mixed-signal blocks.
Design and implement control, protection, fault-handling, and calibration features.
 
What we need to see:
B.S. or MS degree in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent experience)
1-3 years of work on analog–digital co-simulation and digital RTL design for a power controller.
Experience designing and debugging synthesizable Verilog or SystemVerilog RTL.
Flexibility to work across co-simulation and RTL design as project priorities change.
A strong inclination to learn how the analog circuitry behaves. Analog expertise is not required; the team will provide support to help you ramp up.
Strong teamwork and outstanding interpersonal skills.
 
Ways to stand out from the crowd:
Experience with digital control logic in power management or a related system.
Strong knowledge of, or experience working with, mixed-signal and custom-designed IP solutions.
Understanding of firmware and embedded controllers.
Prior exposure to analog design and mixed-signal simulation.
 
Together, let’s push the boundaries of innovation and make a lasting impact on the world. Make the choice, join our diverse team today!

greenhouse:showpad:8319730.title: GTM Engineer
greenhouse:showpad:8319730.text:
Summary: We are seeking a skilled GTM Engineer to join our dynamic team. This role plays a critical part in designing, building, and deploying AI agents and AI-enabled workflows, leveraging advanced technologies to drive business outcomes in a B2B SaaS environment. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in GTM processes, workflow automation, AWS, cloud engineering, and AI technologies.

Responsibilities:

Develop and implement end-to-end GTM strategies and processes within a B2B SaaS environment.

Create and optimize multi-system workflows and automations using REST APIs and event-driven integration patterns.

Design and deploy serverless applications and event-driven architectures using AWS services.

Build and integrate AI agents and workflows using Amazon, Claude/Anthropic models, and approved business systems.

Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business problems into effective technology solutions.

Ensure AI agents and workflows meet standards for accuracy, reliability, scalability, and security.

Contribute to the development of standards for AI agent lifecycle management and observability.

Required Skills:

GTM & Business Experience

6+ years of experience working directly with GTM processes and systems in a B2B SaaS or technology environment.

Strong understanding of end-to-end Lead-to-Revenue and customer lifecycle processes.

Demonstrated understanding of Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations workflows.

Strong understanding of core SaaS commercial concepts and metrics.

Experience translating business problems into process and technology solutions.

Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders and challenge or refine requirements.

Experience working across multiple GTM platforms and understanding cross-system dependencies.

Workflow Automation & Integration

Strong understanding of REST APIs, webhooks, JSON, OAuth, authentication, and event-driven integration patterns.

Experience designing multi-system workflows and automations.

Experience with workflow orchestration technologies.

Ability to evaluate when low-code/no-code automation is appropriate versus custom development.

Experience with platforms such as Zapier, n8n, Workato, Make, Tray.io, or comparable technologies is beneficial but not required.

Experience with web scraping, browser automation, data extraction, or related technologies is beneficial.

Ability to quickly learn and evaluate emerging automation and data acquisition technologies.

AWS & Cloud Engineering

Hands-on experience with AWS Lambda and serverless application patterns.

Experience with AWS Step Functions or comparable workflow orchestration concepts.

Experience with Amazon EventBridge and event-driven architecture.

Experience with Amazon Bedrock or demonstrated experience building applications using foundation-model APIs.

Familiarity with API Gateway, CloudWatch, IAM, Secrets Manager, S3, queues, databases, and related AWS services.

Understanding of cloud security, permissions, monitoring, and production support practices.

AI Agents & Agentic Orchestration

Design, build, and deploy AI agents and AI-enabled workflows within the approved architecture.

Use Amazon and Claude / Anthropic models for reasoning, classification, summarization, research, recommendations, and decision support.

Build agentic workflows combining LLM reasoning with structured business data, APIs, deterministic rules, web-derived information, and approved tools.

Integrate agents with approved business systems and data sources through available APIs, connectors, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) capabilities.

Understand how to discover, configure, and use available MCP servers and tools within AI workflows.

Evaluate when an existing MCP capability can simplify access to a system or data source rather than building a custom integration.

Design prompts, context, structured outputs, tool/function calling, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.

Determine when deterministic workflow logic should be used instead of an LLM or agent.

Test agents and workflows for accuracy, reliability, security, latency, scalability, cost, and measurable business value.

Contribute to standards for agent permissions, observability, evaluation, and lifecycle management.

AI & LLM Technologies

Candidates should have hands-on experience with or strong practical knowledge of:

Claude / Anthropic and/or other leading foundation models

Prompt and context engineering

Structured outputs

Tool / function calling

Agentic workflows and AI orchestration

Model Context Protocol (MCP) concepts and use of MCP-enabled tools

Connecting AI workflows to approved systems and data sources

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts

Human-in-the-loop patterns

Model and agent evaluation

AI observability

AI security, guardrails, data privacy, and responsible AI

Prior MCP experience is beneficial but not required. Candidates should be able to quickly learn and leverage MCP-enabled capabilities as part of AI and automation workflows.
